allowed_source_regions: R07 zero-expiry fixture: capture actual attached pump before fallible public start can retire session reference; validate actual identity/liveness/context after return
forbidden: other tests or unrelated fixture region changes
contract_basis: N10-R07 actual context/current-minimum deadline and no unbound window; public production _stop_background may clear a successfully joined pump. No requirement to retain a finished pump in mutable session field.

oracle_mapping.before: fetch session._pump only after public start; absent reference makes finished false and identity/context false even if production proved join and retired it
oracle_mapping.after: hold actual non-null attached started pump at admission; after public start verify same observed object, real finished and nonalive, exact context; current session reference may equal observed object or be absent only with proof actual observed thread finished. Do not infer completion from None.
retained: actual public return and UNKNOWN_RETAINED/failures examined
fixture salvage not counted as cleanup-at-return

independent_root_cause_review: pending same reviewer; this scope does not close findings
